title: Solve mean-field equations and locate phase boundary
action: Implement the mean-field approximation for the two-sublattice Potts model with four orientations per sublattice. Derive the self-consistent equations for the order parameters and the thermodynamic potential. Perform a parameter sweep over α/(nμ) and βnμ to identify the first-order phase coexistence line where free energies of the two phases are equal, and determine the critical point where the solutions merge.
description: This step performs the core numerical computation to obtain the phase boundary points and the critical point. It produces no scored output file but is required to generate the data for the subsequent scored steps.

title: Output phase boundary points
action: Write the sequence of points (α/(nμ), βnμ) on the first-order coexistence line to phase_boundary.csv. Points should be ordered by increasing α/(nμ).
description: CSV file containing a representative set of points on the liquid-liquid phase transition line.
output_schema: CSV with header: alpha_over_nmu,beta_nmu. Rows: floating‑point values sorted by ascending alpha_over_nmu.

title: Output critical point
action: Write the coordinates (α/(nμ), βnμ) of the critical point to critical_point.csv.
description: CSV file with a single row containing the critical point coordinates.
output_schema: CSV with header: alpha_over_nmu,beta_nmu. Single row of floating‑point values.
